title: Don't Do It!
text:
Don't Do It!. First of all, you can only return this within 30 days and only if you bought it from Zokuhome.com.

I am going to try to return it to Amazon because it's just ridiculous that I used it twice, followed the directions to the letter, and now ... Nothing. Doesn't work.

I am beyond disappointed, and I wish I had paid more attention to the negative reviews.

product_metadata.title: Zoku Duo Quick Pop Maker, Make Popsicles in as Little as 7 Minutes on your Countertop, White
features: SATISFY CRAVINGS IN MINUTES: The patented Zoku Quick Pop Maker freezes ice pops in as little as seven minutes, right on your countertop, no electricity or planning ahead required; just pre-chill the base in freezer so it's ready when you are

PERFECT RESULTS: The nonstick cast-aluminum mold has a proprietary solution sealed inside the base enabling rapid, uniform freezing; the specially designed tool helps to easily release the frozen pops
DOUBLE THE FUN: Makes up to six 2-1/4" x 3-1/2" pops (two 2-ounce pops at a time) before refreezing is required; create a variety of customized popsicles with yogurt, fruit juice and more
MESS-FREE: The durable, reusable sticks have attachable drip-guards and a unique ridged design that allows pops to adhere securely; hand wash only
DETAILS: Includes 4 Sticks, 4 Drip Guards, 1 Duo Quick Pop Maker, and 1 Super Tool for removing the pops; non-toxic and BPA-free; unit measures 5-3/4" x 4-1/2" x 4-3/4"; white
description: The patented Zoku Duo Quick Pop Maker freezes ice pops in as little as seven minutes on your countertop without electricity.

The Zoku Duo makes the same size pops as the original Quick Pop Maker and freezes them just as fast. A smaller and more compact design than the original, the Duo takes up less space in the freezer. The Duo can make up to six pops before refreezing the unit. This little cutie is great for couples, smaller families, or as an addition to the original Zoku for larger families! The Zoku Duo can quickly make striped pops, yogurt pops or for the first time ever at home flavored core pops. To enjoy Quick Pops at a moment’s notice, simply store the compact base in your freezer.

Zoku's specially designed Super Tool helps to quickly release the frozen treats from their molds. Reusable ice pop sticks have fun designs that aid in allowing the pop to adhere and drip guards ensure little hands don’t become sticky.
Includes: 1 Duo Quick Pop Maker, 4 sticks, 4 drip guards, and 1 Super Tool
